ARCHIVE MAIL TERMINAL C
MAIL THREAD / YEAR 6079
FROM: MARA / PAYLOAD SAFETY
TO: FACILITY DIRECTOR<New>Proposal MC-4 replaces the
civil instrument bay with a
strategic warhead cradle.
It breaks Launch Charter 11.
I do not certify it.<New>REPLY: ADVISER'S OFFICE
Objection recorded.
Emergency Continuity Act
permits alternate approval.
Work may proceed.<New>FROM: MARA / TO: LENA
They thanked me for putting
my objection on record. Then
they removed my name from the
approval list.<New>I thought no meant they had
to stop.<New>REPLY: LENA
It should have.
Keep a copy.<Close>
